replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Moved to Map Making.
Feel free to discuss any ideas you have and receive feedback from the community :)
And yes, anyone is free to build and submit maps for Avicus. You can submit your map under the Map Releases section and always remember to follow proper instructions before doing so.
Good luck!
